name: Unknown Places, Typos and Non-Addresses
description: What the parser does with a place it does not know: an old municipality since merged away, a misspelling, a name made up, and text that is not an address at all. Nothing may be invented: an unknown municipality is kept as written and left without a code (validation then reports it), and text that names no place in Japan is null. Original case written for this corpuss.
